description:
Revise docs/ARCHITECTURE.md to reflect the simpler branch topology agreed
with the user on 2026-04-21:

- Dispatches create branches. Steps are linear commits within a branch.
- "Dispatch" is broadened to cover both cases: a user message (spawns an
  exchange off main) and a tool call targeting a subagent (spawns an
  invocation off the dispatching commit).
- Intermediate compaction added: the compactor may run at checkpoints
  during a branch's execution (not only at termination), producing a
  current-state summary that is merged up to the parent. Each checkpoint
  replaces the previous summary. Parent never sees internal state, only
  progressively richer compacted views.

=== Sections to revise ===

§2.1 Terms: widen "Dispatch" to "the event that spawns a branch with a
goal. Two cases: a user message (spawns an exchange off main) and a tool
call targeting a subagent (spawns an invocation off the dispatching
commit)."

§2.3 Branches and the branch invariant: rewrite. New invariant —
**every dispatch creates a branch**. Branch classes reduce to two:
exchange branches (root: off main) and invocation branches (nested: off
the commit on the parent branch where the dispatch landed). Remove
"step branch" as a class. Steps are commits on the current branch, not
sub-branches. Lifecycle unchanged. Update the naming conventions
accordingly.

§2.5 Invocations and dispatch: rewrite the nesting and streaming
reprompt paragraphs. Dispatch tool calls spawn invocation branches off
the commit where the dispatch landed on the parent branch (NOT off any
step branch — there is no such thing). Parallel dispatches from a
single step spawn N sibling invocation branches off the same commit.
Streaming reprompt still holds: each tool return reprompts, each
reprompt is a new step-commit on the parent branch.

§2.7 Compaction: add intermediate compaction (option (a) from the design
discussion):

- Compaction may be invoked at checkpoints during a branch's execution,
  not only at termination.
- Each checkpoint produces a current-state summary and merges only that
  summary to the parent, replacing the previous summary commit (or
  appending — decide shape; replacement keeps parent history clean).
- Triggered by workflow config: every N commits, every T seconds, on
  explicit flush action.
- Terminal compaction is the final such checkpoint.
- Discipline holds: parent never sees raw internal state, only
  compacted views.

§6 Workflow: extend the workflow.yaml example to show a compaction
checkpoint trigger. Add to known actions: `flush` (explicit checkpoint)
and a `compact_every` config under the compactor agent or similar.
Concrete shape is implementer's call as long as it's declarative.

§12 v0.2 Milestone: remove "step branch" from the chain. New copy:
"User message → exchange branch → steps as linear commits → compactor
(deletion-only, stub) → merge." Adjust v0.4 Invocations similarly —
parallel invocations spawn as siblings off the same commit, not off a
step branch.

=== Global scan to do ===

Grep for "step branch" and remove/rephrase all occurrences. The phrase
must not remain anywhere. Grep for "sub-branch" and verify remaining
usages are invocation-sub-branch (valid) rather than step-sub-branch
(invalid).

Check that the terminology table in §2.1 still reflects reality: "Branch
— the git/worktree container for an exchange or invocation". Drop "or
step" from that row.

=== Constraints ===

- Terminology: keep §2.1 canonical. No new terms of art without adding
  them to §2.1 or to docs/TAXONOMY.md (per AGENTS.md Terminology
  discipline).
- The "spawn / work / compact / merge" invariant still holds at every
  branch boundary — just the boundaries move. Phrase it that way.
- Streaming reprompt semantics (§2.5) are unchanged; only the place
  where new branches spawn is changed.
- Do not touch TAXONOMY.md (per global rule).
- Do not add tests since this is a docs-only change; keep the tests
  gate as a no-op verify (existing test suite still passes).

=== Deliverables ===

1. ARCHITECTURE.md revised per above.
2. Commit message explains the invariant change in one paragraph.
3. Gates: tests (existing suite green), docs (the change is the docs),
   alignment (no "step branch" anywhere; §2.1 terms table accurate;
   banned terms still absent).

=== References ===

- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (current draft v0.2).
- docs/TAXONOMY.md §1 (turn/step/loop context).
- Conversation of 2026-04-21: user's articulation — "dispatch creates a
  branch; inside a branch, steps are linear commits; if a step emits a
  new dispatch → new branch; merge up when done; intermediate merges
  allowed as part of compaction procedure."
title: Revise branch invariant: dispatches branch, steps commit
